frontier.brightness: Thin pale warm-white edge is visible across orange/purple seam in all three frames, without large neon halo or flash.
frontier.alignment: The luminous seam visually coincides with the actual shared ownership boundary; no detached trace or arrow observed.
frontier.advance: Three chronological samples show the same irregular boundary advancing northward while losing orange region contracts.

terrain_under_fill.improvement: Actual relief remains visible through both faction fills; opaque acquired purple stripe removed.
terrain_under_fill.gap: Relief is visibly dimpled/lumpy and speckled, especially purple plains and northern green surface. It lacks the concept target smooth natural ridge/valley hierarchy and restrained coherent gold light.
terrain_under_fill.data_limitation: Existing licensed terrain raster/elevation and stylized lighting cannot be certified as reference-equivalent high-detail imagery.
setting_only_recommendations: Consider raising frontier minimumLightingFactor from .58 toward .72-.78 to reduce excessive relief contrast under faction fills.
Consider lowering terrain local baked shade contrast toward 1.05-1.10 after one targeted static check.
Preserve real boundary and geometry; do not manufacture terrain detail or broaden warm light into uniform border glow.

coast_ocean.gap: A broad cyan coastal transition visually resembles an approximately 8-15 px rim in these samples; deep sea has visible directional repeated texture rather than natural multiscale water detail.
coast_ocean.recommendation: Reduce nearshore band width/strength in ocean profile; make transition more gradual and subordinate to frontier, without changing GIS coast.

mobile_hierarchy.units: Eight original full-body silhouettes do not obscure the seam; they are small and non-dominant. Their illustrative flat style does not equal concept art 3D unit rendering.
